meta.title: Puntr referrals | Earn 10–30% recurring Pro commission
meta.description: Invite friends to Puntr and earn 10–30% recurring commission when eligible referrals become paying Puntr Pro subscribers.

referrals.title: Refer friends. Earn recurring Pro commissions.
referrals.subtitle: Share Puntr with your sports community and earn 10–30% recurring commission when eligible referrals become paying Puntr Pro subscribers.
referrals.heading: Grow the community. Share in its growth.
referrals.body: Invite friends to join Puntr, build a public record of their predictions and discover the platform together. When an eligible referral subscribes to Puntr Pro, you can earn recurring commission under the approved referral programme terms.

invite.title: Invite your people
invite.body: Share your personal invite link. A free sign-up is a great start, but Pro subscription commission is earned only when an eligible referral becomes a paying Puntr Pro subscriber.

track.title: Track eligible referrals
track.body: Follow invite activity from your member account. Commission eligibility and payment reporting are governed by the approved programme terms.

guest.title: Get your personal invite link
guest.body: Create a free Puntr account or sign in to access your referral link and activity.

meta.title: PuntPoints | Puntr
meta.description: Discover PuntPoints, Puntr's activity-based loyalty points and member rewards programme.

puntpoints.title: PuntPoints
puntpoints.subtitle: A little recognition for being part of the Puntr community.
puntpoints.heading: Points for participation — and friendly competition.
puntpoints.body: PuntPoints are non-cash loyalty points earned through eligible community activity and rewards. In Community Duels, members can stake eligible PuntPoints in a head-to-head challenge. When the duel is settled, the winner receives the PuntPoints pot. PuntPoints are not real money and cannot be cashed out.

earn.title: Earn through activity
earn.body: Eligible actions can earn points under published programme rules.

explore.title: Explore member rewards
explore.body: Redeem points for available partner perks when the programme is enabled.

transparent.title: Keep it transparent
transparent.body: PuntPoints have no cash value and cannot be exchanged for money. Community Duel stakes are limited to eligible points, and the settled winner receives the pot.

puntpoints.fine: Earning rules, reward availability and duel-staking limits apply. Only eligible points can be staked; account-age and daily limits may apply. PuntPoints do not affect match-pick grading or leaderboard rankings.

meta.title: Live Scores | Puntr
meta.description: The Puntr live scores destination. Follow verified fixture and result updates as live score coverage is introduced.

liveScores.title: Live Scores
liveScores.subtitle: A dedicated matchday destination is being built for Puntr.
liveScores.heading: Live score coverage is coming
liveScores.body: This page is the home for future live match updates. Live scores are not currently available here, and we will not display sample scores as if they were happening now.

fixtures.title: Fixtures and results
fixtures.body: Check the Results area for available fixture and completed-result information.

data.title: Built around reliable data
data.body: Live status and score updates will only appear once a verified data source is connected and operational.

meta.title: Sports Tools | Puntr
meta.description: Explore upcoming Puntr tools: a free Betting Slip Converter, AI Edge Finder summary cards and Punt AI v1.0.

tools.lead: A growing toolkit for South African sports fans who want clearer context and better ways to understand the game. The features below are in development and are not yet available.

converter.name: Betting Slip Converter
converter.description: Planned: import or upload a bookmaker slip to convert selections into trackable Puntr picks. Any AI analysis, community context and fixture checks will be shown only when the relevant integrations are available and verified.

edge.name: AI "Edge Finder" Summary Cards
edge.description: Concise, data-led match summary cards that surface relevant form, context and statistical signals. They are decision-support summaries, not guarantees or instructions to wager.

chat.name: Punt AI v1.0 Chatbot
chat.description: An AI sports assistant for exploring match context, asking questions about available data and understanding the numbers behind a fixture.

pro.title: Go deeper with Puntr Pro
pro.body: These optional tools are planned for Puntr Pro at R99 per month. Core community features remain free.

tools.fine: Tools provide information and context for general use. AI-generated content may be incomplete or inaccurate; check important details independently. Nothing on Puntr guarantees an outcome or constitutes financial advice. 18+ only. Gamble responsibly.

meta.title: South African Bookmaker Directory | Puntr
meta.description: Browse bookmaker licence-holder records published by South Africa's National Gambling Board. Check the regulator, province and licence reference before using any operator.

bookmakers.title: South African Bookmaker Directory
bookmakers.subtitle: A searchable reference to bookmaker licence-holder records published by the National Gambling Board.

independent.title: Check the licence. Make your own decision.
independent.body: Puntr is an independent sports prediction and community platform, not a bookmaker. This directory is informational only. A bookmaker entry does not mean Puntr endorses the operator or that its website is authorised for online betting in every province. Confirm the current licence and approved online betting status directly with the relevant regulator and operator.

bookmakers.fine: Puntr may receive compensation from some partners in future. Any paid relationship will be clearly disclosed. 18+ only. Gamble responsibly.

legal.translationNotice: This is a translation of the English page. If the two differ, the English version applies.
